title: Build the AI Collections Assistant Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/ai-collections-assistant.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/ai-collections-assistant and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/ai-collections-assistant/kit.
Kit contents: Weekly Collections Setup Checklist; Weekly Collections Queue Prompt; Week-to-Week Update Prompt; Skip Rules and Tone Ladder Worksheet; Outcome Log Template; Draft Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Aging Report; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list. Add Playwright coverage for the spec's qa_checks.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/ai-collections-assistant without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'AI Collections Assistant', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a table with exactly 8 data rows whose invoice numbers are INV-3307, INV-3312, INV-3290, INV-3315, INV-3281, INV-3309, INV-3318, and INV-3301. It also shows the as-of date 2026-06-08, the minimum $150, and the tone ladder text 'friendly 1-14 days', 'firm 15-44 days', 'phone call recommended 45+ days'.
Step 2 lists exactly 2 skipped invoices: INV-3312 with reason text containing 'payment promised for 2026-06-12' and INV-3290 with reason text containing 'disputed; needs your decision'.

Step 3 lists exactly 6 queued invoices in this order: INV-3301, INV-3281, INV-3307, INV-3309, INV-3315, INV-3318. Their tones are phone call recommended, phone call recommended, firm, firm, friendly, friendly, and their days overdue are 45, 54, 38, 28, 11, 7.

Step 3 shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. The AI INTERPRETATION line states that no payment history was provided.

Step 4 shows the INV-3307 draft text 'Invoice INV-3307 for $3,900 was due on May 1. Could you confirm when payment will be sent?'. Activating 'Check numbers against the export row' reveals three rows (invoice number, amount, due date), each containing the text 'Matches'.

Step 5 shows the fictional outcome log and a mock next-week run as of 2026-06-15. The run lists INV-3307 as skipped with text containing 'payment promised for 2026-06-19', lists INV-3290 as skipped with text containing 'disputed', and lists the queue INV-3301, INV-3281, INV-3309, INV-3318 in that order.

Step 6 contains the exact sentence 'You send it. Nothing is sent automatically.' and a link to /blueprints/ai-collections-assistant/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every dollar amount and date in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.
Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', '/month', 'per month', or a price. The only dollar figures are the fictional invoice amounts and the fictional $150 minimum.
Neither page contains a percentage, a recovery rate, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.
The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/ai-collections-assistant', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/ai-collections-assistant'.
GET /blueprints/ai-collections-assistant/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/ai-collections-assistant/kit.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/ai-collections-assistant/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts, exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }, and does not add an entry to src/lib/blueprints.ts.
With a signed-in session, the kit page renders h1 'AI Collections Assistant Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Weekly Collections Queue Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'SKIPPED', 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'Apply the skip rules before ranking', 'Use only the invoice number, amount, and due date', 'Do not send', 'Never threaten legal action', 'Do not invent'.
The Week-to-Week Update Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'outcome log', 'promised', 'disputed', 'missed', 'Do not send'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Skip Rules and Tone Ladder Worksheet has inputs with visible labels 'Minimum amount to chase (USD)' (default 150), 'Friendly tone up to (days overdue)' (default 14), 'Firm tone up to (days overdue)' (default 44), and 'Customers to always skip (one per line)', plus a 'Generate My Collections Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Skip invoices under $150', 'Friendly: 1-14 days', 'Firm: 15-44 days', 'Phone call recommended: 45+ days', 'Never threaten legal action.', and 'Do not send anything.'. The block has a Copy button.

If the friendly limit is greater than or equal to the firm limit, the worksheet shows the error 'Friendly limit must be lower than the firm limit.' and generates no rules block. If the minimum is empty or negative, it shows 'Enter a minimum amount of 0 or more.'.
When 'Customers to always skip' is empty, the generated rules block contains no 'Always skip' line. When it contains 'Cedar Row Vet', the block contains 'Always skip: Cedar Row Vet'.

The Outcome Log Template shows the columns week_of, invoice, customer, action_taken, outcome, promised_date, notes and the allowed outcomes paid, promised, disputed, payment plan, no reply. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'week_of,invoice,customer,action_taken,outcome,promised_date,notes'.

The Draft Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.
The Fictional Sample Aging Report section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the 8 invoice rows and header from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With a signed-in session, /my-blueprints contains zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/ai-collections-assistant'.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

All new files are under app/blueprints/ai-collections-assistant/, components/premium/ai-collections-assistant/, src/lib/premium/ai-collections-assistant/, or e2e/ai-collections-assistant/. No existing file is modified.
The guided demo at /blueprints/ai-collections-assistant renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/ai-collections-assistant/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or My Blueprints.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
New Playwright tests exist only under e2e/ai-collections-assistant/, cover the public demo and the signed-in kit, and no existing test is changed or skipped.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
